scope: Read-only frozen source snapshots and local captured HTML/screenshots only. No live website or production route inspected.

observations.observation: The four long node labels collapse into a narrow, overlapping row in the captured local HTML. The metadata reports tikz_count=1 and no renderer diagram failure, but individual visual review shows the labels are not legible as a flow diagram.
observations.repair_guidance: Re-layout nodes with adequate spacing or stack the stages; preserve flow observations → estimates → all finer-index comparisons → smallest accepted index.

missing_diagram_candidates.rationale: The source gives explicit ordered control flow, several terminal statuses, and a bounded backtracking loop; a small flowchart would make the branch order easier to scan.
draw_or_check: initial admissibility → inadmissible or initialize q
state-adjoint solve → solve-certificate failure or certified gradient/data outputs
iteration limit/objective interval checks → budget-exhausted or linear-solve-failed
backtracking projected trials: reject unchanged/inadmissible, evaluate certified interval, accept first upper <= current lower, otherwise budget-exhausted
